description: Tapp's platform-neutral UI Map: observed screen states, semantic controls, transitions, provenance and Task/contract coverage. action `read` returns one (repo .tapp/ui-map.json or a capture's); `build` merges a map from OCQA evidence; `diff` reports additions and absences, calling absence a lost state only when comparableFullSweep is true. No AI.

comparableFullSweep.description: diff: both runs had comparable budget; permits lost-reachability classification

markersPath.description: build: repo-relative OCQA markers when captureId is not supplied

target.description: Bundle id, app id, or owned URL recorded as provenance

name: tapp_map
title: The UI Map: read, build, or diff
